ratings.note: Frequency occasional: only skippers who go Back from review (e.g. to correct a detail) meet it, but that is in the critical booking journey. Impact significant: all four fields incl. the 9-digit MMSI must be re-typed on a phone, often one-handed, with autocomplete off; short of the 3 anchor since the data is re-enterable from the skipper's own knowledge. Persistence: recurs on every return, learning only helps by avoiding Back. s = 3, value matches.
